summary_en: Keywest Network LLC to acquire all Future Corporation ordinary shares (excluding Kanemarui's existing 30.18M shares (34.02% S/O), treasury, and restricted shares) via public tender to delist. Kanemarui Yasufumi (CEO, 12.53% S/O, beneficial owner of Keywest via Dana Point Corporation PTE) is promoter. Tender price, period, and total acquisition budget not disclosed in excerpt. Keywest to convert from LLC to KK after settlement closes.
title_en: Notice regarding commencement of public tender offer for Future Corporation (securities code: 4722) shares by Keywest Network LLC
translation_en_brief: On 29 July 2026, Keywest Network LLC (a limited liability company controlled by Kanemarui Yasufumi, Future's Chairman and the company's second-largest shareholder at 12.53% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) announced the commencement of a public tender offer to acquire all ordinary shares of Future Corporation (TSE Prime, code 4722) for the purpose of delisting the company. This transaction constitutes a management buyout (MBO). Keywest currently owns 30,187,000 shares (34.02% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) as of 29 July 2026. The tender offer excludes shares already held by Keywest, Future's treasury shares, and restricted shares awarded to directors and employees. Kanemarui intends to continue as Chairman post-transaction and drive medium-to-long-term enterprise value. The filing excerpt does not disclose the tender price, acquisition budget, or tender period. Keywest plans to convert from LLC to a joint-stock company after settlement is complete. Detailed post-transaction governance and management structure will be determined in consultation with Future following close.
